annotations.title: Create a TikTok Smart+ campaign (forced paused)

description: Create an UPGRADED SMART+ campaign — TikTok’s automated campaign type, where TikTok picks the audience, placements and creative combinations for you. It is what a customer means by "smart campaign", "automated campaign", "performance max" or "Smart+" on TikTok. CREATED PAUSED WITH NO OVERRIDE, exactly like the classic lane and for the same reason: TikTok creates ENABLED by default, so an omitted status would ship something that serves on the next auction. It spends nothing until set_tiktok_smart_status(confirm:true). SMART+ TAKES A SHORTER OBJECTIVE LIST THAN A CLASSIC CAMPAIGN — APP_PROMOTION, WEB_CONVERSIONS, LEAD_GENERATION and nothing else — and a value TikTok accepts on the classic endpoint can still be refused here, at the ad group, after the campaign exists; that is refused up front instead. CATALOG ADS: set catalogEnabled and catalogType (ECOMMERCE for a commerce catalog; GENERIC for itemized NON-commerce inventories; TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT for hotels, flights and destinations, on WEB_CONVERSIONS or, since TikTok added App Travel Catalog Ads on 2026-11-06, on APP_PROMOTION). There is no PRODUCT catalog type.

advertiserId.description: which advertiser; omit when the profile has one

appPromotionType.description: REQUIRED when the objective is APP_PROMOTION. MINIS promotes a Series or mini game

budget.description: campaign budget in the advertiser currency

budgetMode.description: the valid set depends on budgetOptimizeOn: DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET or TOTAL with CBO on (the default), INFINITE / DAY / TOTAL with CBO off. Everything except INFINITE also needs budget

budgetOptimizeOn.description: campaign budget optimisation (CBO). TikTok is retiring non-CBO App Install VBO campaigns via the API at the end of September 2026, so leave this true for APP_INSTALL

catalogType.description: required when catalogEnabled, and the valid set depends on the OBJECTIVE: WEB_CONVERSIONS takes ECOMMERCE / TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT / MINI_SERIES / GENERIC, LEAD_GENERATION takes GENERIC only, APP_PROMOTION takes ONLINE_TO_OFFLINE or TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT. MINI_SERIES and both APP_PROMOTION catalog types are allowlist-only at TikTok

isPromotionalCampaign.description: promotion campaign settings for a launch, event or time-bound offer. Only for APP_PROMOTION with appPromotionType APP_INSTALL (allowlist-only at TikTok) or WEB_CONVERSIONS with salesDestination WEBSITE

salesDestination.description: REQUIRED for WEB_CONVERSIONS: where the sales happen. APP additionally needs a catalog; WEB_AND_APP drives sales on both
